name: GitHub
description: Your repos, pull requests, issues and Actions runs, with a failed run's log, with a token of yours.

preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: A fine-grained token (github.com › Settings › Developer settings › Personal access tokens › Fine-grained tokens) with Read-only for Metadata, Pull requests, Issues and Actions, on the repos you want (Get One… fills these in). One sees a single account's or organization's repos; for all of yours, a classic token with the repo scope. It's used only to ask GitHub's API.
